content: सिद्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Accomplished, effected, performed, achieved, completed. .²2 Gained, obtained, acquired. .²3 Succeeded, successful; one who has attained his object; यातावला व्रजं सिद्धा मयेमा रंस्यथ क्षपाः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 22. 27</ls>. .²4 Settled, established; नैसर्गिकी सुरभिणः कुसुमस्य सिद्धा मूर्ध्नि स्थितिर्न चरणैरवताडनानि <ls>U. 1. 14</ls>. .²5 Proved, demonstrated, substantiated; तस्मादिन्द्रियं प्रत्यक्षप्रमाणमिति सिद्धम् <ls>T. S.</ls>; साक्षिप्रत्ययसिद्धानि (कार्याणि) <ls>Ms. 8. 178</ls>. .²6 Valid, sound (as a rule). .²7 Admitted to be true. .²8 Decided, adjudicated (as a law-suit). .²9 Paid, discharged, liquidated (as debt). .²10 Cooked, dressed (as food); अभ्रच्छाया खलप्रीतिः सिद्धमन्नं च योषितः . किंचित्कालोपभोग्यानि यौवनानि धनानि च .. <ls>Pt. 2. 117</ls>. .²11 Matured, ripened. .²12 Thoroughly prepared, compounded, cooked together (as drugs). .²13 Ready (as money). .²14 Subdued, won over, subjugated (as by magic). .²15 Brought under subjection, become propitious. .²16 Thoroughly conversant with or skilled in, proficient in; as in रससिद्ध <ab>q. v.</ab> .²17 Perfected, sanctified (as by penance); अप्रमत्तोऽखिलस्वार्थे यदि स्यात् सिद्ध आत्मनि <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 29</ls>. .²18 Emancipated. .²19 Endowed with supernatural powers or faculties. .²20 Pious, sacred, holy. .²21 Divine, immortal, eternal. .²22 Celebrated, well-known, illustrious; अथर्वशिरसि प्रोक्तैर्मन्त्रैः सिद्धां विधानतः <ls>Rām. 1. 15. 2</ls>; एवं तौ लोकसिद्धाभिः क्रीडाभिश्चेरतुर्वने <ls>Mb. 10. 18. 16</ls>. .²23 Shining, splendid. .²24 Hit (as a mark). .²25 Peculiar, singular. .²26 Invariable, unalterable. .²27 Satisfied; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 29</ls>. .{@-द्धः@} .²1 A semi-divine being supposed to be of great purity and holiness, and said to be particularly characterized by eight supernatural faculties called {%Siddhis%} <ab>q. v.</ab>; उद्वेजिता वृष्टिभिराश्रयन्ते शृङ्गाणि यस्यातपवन्ति सिद्धाः <ls>Ku. 1. 5</ls>. .²2 An inspired sage or seer (like Vyāsa). .²3 Any sage or seer, a prophet; सिद्धादेश <ls>Ratn. 1</ls>. .²4 One skilled in magical arts, a magician. .²5 A law-suit, judicial trial. .²6 A kind of hard sugar. .²7 The dark thorn-apple. .²8 One who has attained his object; सिद्धः कचो वत्स्यति मत्सकाशे <ls>Mb. 1. 76. 70</ls>. .{@-द्धम्@} Sea-salt.
